title: Warmth without visual noise
body: We hung the 36×48 opposite a linen sofa. The texture shows up beautifully after 4pm. Studio helped confirm size from our wall photo, which saved us from going too small.

photos.prompt: Customer-style phone photo of a warm amber textured abstract canvas on a living-room wall above a linen sofa, late-afternoon side light, realistic home clutter minimal, no faces, no logos.
photos.alt: Amber abstract canvas above a linen sofa in afternoon light

title: Looks larger in person
body: Ordered the 40×54 for our dining wall. Scale feels right — present, not overwhelming. Packaging was solid and the canvas arrived ready to hang. Brush ridges are clearer than on screen.

photos.prompt: Phone photo of a large abstract canvas in a dining room, soft daylight, oak table edge visible, natural perspective, not catalog-perfect.
photos.alt: Large canvas on dining room wall

photos.prompt: Close-up of acrylic and plaster texture on canvas, visible brush ridges, soft daylight, shallow depth of field.

title: Colour matched better than expected
body: I sent a room photo and they suggested a slightly warmer beige. Glad we asked. It feels handmade, which is what we wanted versus a flat print. Delivery took about nine days.

photos.prompt: Bedroom wall with soft beige textured painting, linen bedding corner visible, quiet morning light, realistic residence.
photos.alt: Beige textured painting in a bedroom

title: Clear updates, careful crate
body: About ten days door to door. The team answered size questions quickly. Corner protection was excellent. Colour is a touch deeper than my monitor, still works with our oak floors.

photos.prompt: Opened protective art crate corner on a clean wood floor, kraft paper and foam visible, canvas edge partly shown, realistic home setting.

title: Custom size for a narrow hallway
body: Needed a panoramic piece for a tight corridor. They confirmed proportions before painting. It feels intentional, not like a cropped square work. Guests notice it immediately.

photos.prompt: Panoramic abstract canvas in a narrow residential hallway, soft overhead light, wood floor, realistic phone photo.

title: Quiet enough for a bedroom
body: Wanted something calm for above the bed. Greens and soft white read gently at night. Stretched frameless option looks clean. Will order a smaller piece for the office next.

title: Studio advice was practical
body: I almost chose a size too wide for our sofa wall. Their quick reply with a tape-measure guide fixed it. The finished piece anchors the room without shouting.

photos.prompt: Living room focal wall with hand-painted abstract art above a modern sofa, overcast daylight through sheer curtains, lived-in realistic photo.
photos.alt: Abstract painting above a modern sofa

title: Texture is the reason we bought
body: Photos helped, but the plaster relief is why it works in person. Side light from the window makes it change through the day. Packing was museum-careful.

photos.prompt: Macro of plaster and acrylic relief on canvas, raking daylight, documentary feel, no watermark.
photos.alt: Macro texture of plaster relief on canvas

photos.prompt: Modern apartment wall with textured abstract canvas, cool daylight, minimal furniture edge, realistic.
photos.alt: Textured canvas on an apartment wall
